notes.title: New Update: Philips Hue Lights support and more!
notes.notes:
[h1]Philips Hue Lights support[/h1]
We've teamed up with Philips to offer one of the world's first fully immersive living room gaming experiences. 
Check out just how immersive your Chariot experience can become when your whole living room lights up to match the game's ambiance:[url]http://www.digitaltrends.com/home/philips-hue-light-bulbs-now-sync-with-video-game-chariot/[/url]

OTHER FEATURES/CHANGES
•	New Japanese localisation and voice over support
•	User can now remove controller vibration in the options
•	Added flavor quotes for the shopkeeper
•	Added King’s congrats quote at the end of a level
•	New checkpoints have been added to various levels.
•	Other bugs and issues have been corrected

*The content provided in this update is available to all players. DLC purchase is not required. 

[i]We hope you enjoy this new content. Thank you for playing Chariot![/i]

notes.title: New DLC Available: The Royal Gadget Pack
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTER: the Shopkeeper[/h1]
Available in solo or co-op, the quirky skeleton merchant comes with his own unique attack move:  a bouncing bone projectile. Used in combination with the Royal Arms gadget, the spinning bone becomes a floating platform, allowing the Shopkeeper or his partner to perform otherwise impossible jumps.

[h1]5 NEW GADGETS[/h1]
Some of them will delight the speedrunning community, while others will make some of the harder levels somewhat easier for less experienced players. For everyone else, it will offer new ways to explore the world’s mysterious caves, collect even more of that sweet loot, and reach the final resting place of the King with added style.

[list][*][b]Shield Bubble:[/b] Protects you from everything - including looters! Hold jump to bounce. 
[*][b]Stasis Field:[/b] Freezes EVERYTHING in place (except people). Skeletons are people too.
[*][b]Omni Boots:[/b] Allows you to walk normally on any surface - ice, quicksand, even lava!
[*][b]Royal Arms:[/b] Gives each character their own special attack
[*][b]Warp Beacon:[/b] Use to set beacon; use again to warp the Chariot (and any riders).[/list]

Straight from the royal engineers' workshop, these gadgets are available at level 1, with 2 upgrade blueprints per gadget hidden in existing levels.

[h1]10 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1]
[list][*][b]That’s the Plan:[/b] Find all standard and royal gadget blueprints
[*][b]Off to Adventure and All That:[/b] Complete a level with the shopkeeper
[*][b]Unbankable:[/b] Reach the exit of the hidden level with every single piece of loot in the Chariot
[*][b]Not All It’s Cracked Up To Be:[/b] Go swimming in lava pool and emerge unscathed
[*][b]Break Everything:[/b] Finish the Chasm Crossing speed run within 70 seconds
[*][b]Half of Zero is Still Zero:[/b] Use the Slowdown while the Statis Field is active
[*][b]All Aboard:[/b] Have 20 looters looting the Chariot at the same time
[*][b]Had You Worried There:[/b] Warp an off-screen Chariot with less than a second to spare
[*][b]Grounded:[/b] Use the Omni Boots to withstand 10 Flipper flips
[*][b]Royal Sampler:[/b] Try out all three versions of the Royal Arms[/list]

Thank you for playing Chariot!

notes.title: COGWATCH 2. Chariot
notes.notes:
Hey! It’s a new weekly video series from Quinns talking about one mechanic in one game. Part one was on rhythm in Crypt of the Necrodancer. Part two is about co-op in Chariot [official site], a platformer in which you and a friend use ropes to push, pull, catch and carry an object through the game world.

notes.title: Chariot Speed Run Contest
notes.notes:
Hello Chariot community!

We're excited to launch the very first Chariot co-op Speed Run contest today.
Team up, brush up your co-op skills and run The Prismatic Eye ( 2-5 ) in Speed Run mode as fast as you can and aim for the grand prize of 1000$.

For more information, see the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/319450/discussions/0/617328967246502810/] forum thread [/url] 

You have until March 23rd to participate. Good luck!

notes.title: Two new videos!
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

We've just added two new videos to the Store Page and you should definitely check them out.

The Developer Diary is an interview video featuring a couple of key members from the Chariot team talking about how the game came to be and where it comes from. If you love the game and are curious about it's development, you should find the video very interesting!

The Tips and Tricks is a video we made to showcase some of the awesome moves you can do in Chariot with the gadgets or just the ropes. If you're struggling on a puzzle, the Tips and Tricks should give you some ideas on how to solve it. It's also a good reminder of just how useful the gadgets are when you play solo.

Enjoy the videos and tell us what you think!

notes.title: New Chariot update
notes.notes:
Release notes for November 25th 2014

-Added UI elements to better track the % of the levels revealed to the player. It will greatly help achieve the 'royal cartographer' achievement.
-Fixed a bug where the saved game would appear as 'new'.
-Added some missing SFX feedback when using the mouse
-Fixed a sound bug where the 'unstable crate sound' would keep looping if the character died while it was playing.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Chariot
notes.notes:
Chariot is Now Available on Steam!

Embark on a journey to give his majesty the ride of his afterlife. Guide a chariot containing the King's remains through underground caves using physics-based mechanics such as pushing, pulling, riding and swinging. Alone or with a friend, lead the brave Princess and her faithful Fiancé into the royal catacombs to find the perfect resting place for the King!

notes.title: Chariot is coming to Steam on November 12th
notes.notes:
Find a co-op buddy, dust-off your controllers and get ready to venture forth into the Royal Catacombs as Chariot is releasing for PC on November 12th.

If you read this and are excited about the game, please share the news with your friends, with your family, with your coworkers and with anyone you stumble upon playing games on Steam. We need to get the word out that the King is dead!
